item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy\\nfrom work import evaluate\\ncases=[({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2}]},{'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':3},'unique':False},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':6}],'errors':[]}),({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'a','amount':3}]},{'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':True},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'},{'row':4,'cause':'duplicate'}]}),({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'y','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'z','amount':-0.0}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':2},'unique':False},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'}]})]\\nfor req,pol,expected in cases:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert (req,pol)==before\\nprint('boundary tests passed',len(cases))\"]}"}
